note: group systems is the closest of the five atlas groups (information flowing through a process); the page is molecular biology

description.zh: 复制靠碱基配对（A 对 T、G 对 C）照着旧链拼新链，子代 DNA 各留一条旧链，这就是半保留复制；随后信息从 DNA 转录成 RNA、再翻译成蛋白质，一个碱基的点突变就可能改变一个氨基酸。标准密码表，忽略链方向与大量酶学细节。
description.en: Copying works by base pairing (A with T, G with C): each new strand is built against an old one, so every daughter DNA keeps one old strand — semi-conservative replication. The message is then transcribed from DNA to RNA and translated into protein, where a single-base point mutation can change one amino acid. Standard code table, ignoring strand direction and most enzymology.

reason.zh: 基因传给后代的概率，根子在分子事件里：复制保真度、突变、染色体分离方式，决定了后代拿到哪个版本——概率页的数字，正是这些分子事件的统计结果。
reason.en: The odds of passing a gene to offspring are rooted in molecular events: copying fidelity, mutation and how chromosomes separate decide which version offspring get — the probability lesson's numbers are the statistics of those molecular events.

reason.zh: 突变是随机事件：要估计一群基因里出现某种突变的比例，就得像蒙特卡洛那样大量随机抽样、数出频率——突变页的“随机”正是抽样估计的对象。
reason.en: Mutations are random events: to estimate how often a given mutation shows up in a population of genes, you sample at random many times and count the frequency, Monte Carlo style — the replication lesson's 'random' is exactly what sampling estimates.

title.zh: 基因里的信息怎样变成蛋白质？
title.en: How does the information in a gene become a protein?

ask.zh: 碱基配对保证复制时新链和旧链互补——半保留复制是什么意思？子代 DNA 里旧链占几条？
ask.en: Base pairing makes each new strand complement the old — what does semi-conservative replication mean? How many old strands does each daughter DNA carry?

ask.zh: 转录和翻译各把信息从什么变成什么？点突变改变的是碱基还是整个基因？
ask.en: Transcription and translation each convert information from what into what? Does a point mutation change a base or a whole gene?

reveal.zh: DNA 半保留复制传下信息，转录成 RNA、翻译成蛋白质；点突变只改一个碱基，就可能改变一个氨基酸。
reveal.en: DNA copies semi-conservatively to pass information on, transcribes it to RNA and translates it into protein; a point mutation changes a single base, which can change one amino acid.
